moments.description: A black screen is displayed before the application loads.
The TodoMVC page loads showing the "todos" title and "What needs to be done?" input field while the cursor moves around.
The user types "Buy milk" into the input field and presses Enter.
The user types "Finish the hackathon demo video" into the input field and presses Enter.
The user types "Call mom" into the input field and presses Enter.
The user types "fix lgoin bug", corrects it to "fix login bug", and presses Enter.
The list of 4 items is displayed while the mouse cursor hovers and moves across the screen.
The user checks the completion checkboxes for "Fix login bug" and "Finish the hackathon demo video".
The items "Fix login bug" and "Finish the hackathon demo video" appear with strikethrough text marking them completed.
The user clicks on the "Active" filter button.
The active tasks "Call mom" and "Buy milk" are displayed.
The user clicks on the "Completed" filter button.
The completed tasks "Fix login bug" and "Finish the hackathon demo video" are displayed.
The user clicks on the "All" filter button.
All four todo items are displayed while the cursor moves toward the "Completed" filter tab.
